title: Market Manager - Malaysia, Singapore & Greater China
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

Based in the Kuala Lumpur or Jakarta area.


PUT YOUR COMMERCIAL JUDGMENT AND ANALYSIS BEHIND THE GROWTH OF AN ENTIRE HOTEL MARKET.

Nuitée is growing its direct relationships with hotels across the Asia Pacific region, and Malaysia, Singapore & Greater China are ready for someone to take full ownership of it. As Market Manager, you'll be the go-to person for every hotel in your portfolio. You'll set the commercial strategy, get pricing and promotions right, and make sure each property is fully live and performing at its best.

You'll work hand in hand with hotel revenue managers, GMs and cluster teams, using Nuitée's dashboards to spot opportunities early and turn them into results.

This isn't a mature book with limited upside. It's a hands-on, high-ownership role where you shape the market, with real autonomy to run your portfolio the way you think is best.


WHAT MAKES IT INTERESTING FOR YOU:

 - You build and grow your own portfolio instead of maintaining someone else's, so your impact is fast and visible

 - You decide the commercial strategy for every hotel you manage: pricing, promotions, restrictions and room-type coverage

 - You deal directly with hotel revenue managers and GMs, with nobody between you and the decision

 - Nuitée just rebuilt its hotel extranet from the ground up, so you'll have sharper pricing and promotion tools than most account managers get elsewhere

 - The APAC team is scaling, with room to grow into a senior or multi-market role across the region

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, stayed profitable the entire time, and raised a $48M Series A led by Accel. Demand partners like Grab and Priceline already send bookings through Nuitée's platform, and direct supply, the inventory you'd own, is a growing priority for where that demand gets filled.


THE KIND OF PROBLEMS YOU'LL WORK ON:

 - How do you get a newly contracted hotel live, fully distributed and producing bookings, fast?

 - What's actually stopping a specific hotel from winning more business: price, availability, restrictions, or something technical?

 - How do you negotiate pricing and promotions that make a hotel genuinely competitive?

 - How do you turn a quarterly business review into a plan a hotel actually acts on?

 - How do you turn a dashboard full of data into the three things worth fixing today?


THIS ROLE FITS YOU IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years in hotel account management, revenue management or market management, ideally at an OTA or bed bank

 - Understand B2B hotel distribution, its competitors, and how commercial terms affect performance.

 - Live comfortably in dashboards and turns data into action instead of just tracking it

 - Can sit across from a hotel revenue manager or GM and negotiate real pricing and promotion improvements

 - Build pipeline and strategy on your own initiative, without waiting for leads or scripts

 - Speak fluent English, and know the relevant area's hotel landscape

 - Have worked independently in a fast-moving environment. Revenue-management experience is a plus.


WORKING STYLE AND CULTURE

Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your work actually delivers.

If this sounds like your kind of market management role, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Mid-Market Implementation Manager
description:
About Kojo 
 It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.
 Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.
 About the Role
 The Mid-Market Implementation Manager is the primary point of contact for new Kojo customers after contract signature. You own the project and the customer relationship through implementation, then hand a trained, live customer to their Customer Success Manager. The role combines project management, technical aptitude, training, and problem-solving, and you run your portfolio independently.
 The customers and portfolio:
 Customers: Mid-market commercial and specialty trade contractors (electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and others) with contracts of $60,000 ARR or less
 Portfolio: Typically 15–20 active implementations at a time, varying with project complexity and customer demand
 Timeline: Implementations typically run 3–6 months, with a target go-live around 90 days whenever feasible
 Stakeholders: Business owners, operations leaders, purchasing managers, accounting teams, warehouse personnel, and field employees
 This role will include:
 Leading customer kickoffs: aligning stakeholders, establishing implementation goals, and setting clear expectations on responsibilities, milestones, and timelines
 Owning each implementation from kickoff through graduation: building and maintaining project plans, tracking milestones, managing risks, and holding both Kojo and the customer accountable for deliverables
 Mapping each customer’s existing procurement, purchasing, accounting, and operational workflows, and showing how Kojo improves them
 Building training plans based on the modules each customer purchased and leading live training sessions so every team is ready to use Kojo confidently, including occasional travel to customer sites across North America
 Coordinating ERP integrations, configuration requirements, and technical dependencies with Solutions Architects and technical teams. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable with technical concepts and communicating requirements
 Driving go-live and time to value: monitoring progress, removing roadblocks, and getting customers using Kojo in their daily operations as quickly as possible
 Identifying risks early and escalating blockers before they become major issues
 Partnering with Solutions Architects, Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Customer Success to resolve challenges, and sharing customer themes with the Product team
 Transitioning trained, operationally ready customers to their Customer Success Manager
 What Makes This Role Unique
 High ownership and autonomy: You own your customer portfolio and are trusted to make the decisions that keep projects moving
 Strategic and hands-on work: One day you’re leading a customer kickoff, the next you’re training a purchasing team or untangling a complicated workflow
 Meaningful customer impact: You help construction businesses modernize how they purchase materials, work with suppliers, and run critical operations
 Cross-functional exposure: You work closely with teams across Kojo , building both technical knowledge and broader business experience
 Fast-paced environment: Priorities shift, and you stay organized and keep customers confident through ambiguity
 Professional growth: You build experience in project delivery, customer leadership, business process improvement, and professional services
 About You
 An organized, technically curious project manager who earns customer trust will thrive in this role! If you’re excited about owning implementations end to end and delivering measurable customer outcomes, apply with us! 
 What you’ve accomplished:
 3–6 years of B2B SaaS implementation experience, owning multiple customer implementations from kickoff through go-live
 Strong project management: you keep many projects on schedule at once and hold stakeholders accountable
 Technical aptitude, particularly with ERP integrations and business workflows
 Experience delivering product trainings, both virtually and in person, that turn into real adoption
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in front of a variety of technical and non-technical audiences
 A track record of working independently, navigating ambiguity, and escalating issues thoughtfully
 Experience in construction technology, procurement, financial software, ERP, or a similar operational SaaS environment is a plus; direct industry experience isn’t required
 What you care about:
 Customer Obsession: You understand that what might be small things to us make a huge difference for them
 Passion: You care intensely about Kojo ’s success
 Impact: You are both fast-paced and detail oriented
 Innovation: You seek to understand the truth behind problems and find solutions to them
 What Success Looks Like
 A successful Mid-Market Implementation Manager:
 Consistently drives customers to go-live within established timelines
 Manages a portfolio of 15–20 active customers without sacrificing communication or implementation quality
 Identifies risks and escalates blockers before they become major issues
 Builds strong relationships and earns customers’ trust
 Delivers training that translates into meaningful product adoption
 Maintains accurate project documentation and clear visibility into implementation heal
